about: Synthetic reconcile cases. Expected values are subsets: dict keys listed must match exactly; lists must match in length and order. Hand checks: 10 x 30.00 = 300.00; option 2 contracts x 3.40 x 100 = 680.00; crypto 0.42 x 2600.00 (stop) = 1092.00; KO 2 x 71.55 = 143.10. The 120 s fallback window is inclusive (120 s matches, 121 s does not).
